description: Preventive Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow Dataset with Renewable Energy Sources (PSCOPF-RES) is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Runsheng He. "PSCOPF-RES provides a benchmark dataset for Preventative Safety-Constrained Optimal Power Flow (SCOPF) on designed IEEE 24R systems, including renewable energy sources. This dataset contains 22 million feasible operating scenarios, selected from an initial pool of 40 million samples and organized into four subsets, each containing 5.6 million scenarios, to support different sampling strategies. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
